plaintext.output_format: UTF-8 text/plain; parser-IR node order; no trailing newline added by policy

node_policies.gaiji: append gaiji.unicode when present, otherwise gaiji.raw_marker
node_policies.layout-span: emit visible text or visible inline children only; omit layout metadata and ruby readings
node_policies.heading: surround text with newlines
node_policies.indentation: append text when present, otherwise omit and report
node_policies.image: append alt when present, otherwise omit and report
node_policies.caption: append text
node_policies.quote: append text when present, otherwise omit and report
node_policies.source-note: append front/back source notes outside body text; append body source notes inline

tei.output_format: TEI P5 XML body hiccup rendered under the ABC TEI profile

node_policies.ruby: ruby type=furigana rb/rt with optional direction rend; furigana is the default Aozora heuristic
node_policies.layout-span: render as TEI hi@rend with abc:* profile tokens; exact source marker identity remains in ABC custom preservation evidence
node_policies.heading: body head
node_policies.caption: figDesc
